description: This file defines the base class for MediaKeys IPC tests, including setup and teardown of IPC channels, creation and destruction of MediaKeys IPC objects, and handling of event subscriptions and responses. It provides mock interactions and utility functions for testing MediaKeys IPC functionality within a media application.

classes.name: MediaKeysIpcTestBase
classes.description: A base class for testing MediaKeys IPC interactions, providing setup, teardown, and utility functions for mocking IPC channels and events.

methods.name: MediaKeysIpcTestBase::MediaKeysIpcTestBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing mock objects for IPC testing.

methods.name: createMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Creates and initializes the MediaKeys IPC object, setting up necessary mocks and expectations.

methods.name: destroyMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Destroys the MediaKeys IPC object and cleans up subscriptions.

methods.name: expectSubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for subscribing to specific IPC events.

methods.name: expectUnsubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for unsubscribing from IPC events.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session via IPC and sets up the response.

methods.name: createLicenseRenewalEvent
methods.description: Constructs a LicenseRenewalEvent message with current test data.

methods.name: setCreateMediaKeysResponse
methods.description: Sets the response data for createMediaKeys IPC call.

methods.name: setCreateKeySessionResponseSuccess
methods.description: Sets the response data for createKeySession IPC call indicating success.

methods.name: convertMediaKeyErrorStatus
methods.description: Converts internal MediaKeyErrorStatus enum to protobuf error status.
